page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running title and ornament at the top; a heading block, then a sub-heading "ADDITA", then a list-like run of entries with a large woodcut initial D. No marginal notes. Catchword line "Dist." at the lower right.

main_text.head: ELENCHVS EORVM, QVAE HOC PRIMO LIBRO SENTENTIARVM in citanda tum S. Scriptura, tum Patrum autoritate sunt à P. Lombardo vel addita, vel detracta, vel commutata, vel lapsu memoriæ suppositæ.
ADDITA
main_text.p: Distinctio 2. cap.8. ad dictum Ambrosij additur vox, Natura.
Dist.3.cap.1.ad Paulum Romanor.cap.1. vers.20. vox, Innuisibiles.
Distinct.6.in margine cap.3.ad Hilarium, neque consilio.
Distinct.8.cap.1.ad Hierony. Quia in eius comparatione.
Distinct.19. cap.2. ad postremum August. dictum addit falsam interpretationem vocis generationum.

page.notes: The large initial D is a woodcut letter. Ornamental running-title border at top. Some entries are set in roman with italic key words; the line "Dist." at the lower right is a catchword. Reading of "Dist.3" and "Distinct.6" follows the scan; "Distinct.19" may be misprinted. Left edge shows show-through from the reverse page.
